about: CyberPet sprite sets loaded on demand by /petz/x/assets.js. Each set: files (in /petz/x/art/<set>/ unless dir is given), optional json (frame data), lo:true when @lo copies exist. Empty sets fall back to drawn effects until the art from the ChatGPT prompt kit arrives (block 15).

glass.use: Close-up face, paw, tongue, fog and smear frames

petting.use: Purr loops, roll-over, stretch, reactions per zone

clouds.use: Sleep cloud frames, rare cloud variants

room.use: Item interaction animations and costume overlays
